meta.name: OPPS — action award spec
meta.summary: Relative weights for what each player action is worth. Paid in CLOUT, the games one currency — there is no separate XP.

adopted.what: actionXp only — the relative weight of one action against another.
adopted.notWhat: The 1-100 curve, its level thresholds and its 2,245,525 lifetime total. data/progression.json is the single authority for the level curve and stays so; see data/README.md. Do not re-add a levels block here.
adopted.ruling: DOM-124, Jake 2026-09-15, option (a): keep one currency (Clout) and the repo 1.10 curve; harvest this file for content only.
adopted.titles: The 100 rank titles from the source levels[] were lifted into data/ranks.json and spread across the repos 120 levels.

scale.note: These numbers are SPEC WEIGHTS, not Clout. js/xp.js converts one to the other against data/progression.json — see xpScale() there for the policy and its open question.

unpaid.note: opps and missions.sideHustles are recorded here for completeness but are NOT paid from this file. data/enemies.json and data/jobs.json already price those two actions, level-scaled, and DOM-67 calibrates them. Paying both would double-pay; replacing them would overwrite a calibrated economy with a flat table. See js/xp.js XP_UNPAID.

mainStory.note: Featured / main-job beats in MAKE MOVES. Largest single XP sources; pace the core climb.

sideHustles.note: Side hustles in MAKE MOVES. Repeatable, mid-size awards.

daily.note: Daily objectives + login. Small, steady drip to reward showing up.

plugs.note: NPC suppliers in PLUGS. Recruiting a plug, then completing the job they offer.
